title: Meter
description: A measured level with a tick scale — storage, capacity, load. The scale is part of the component.
usage: For a value that has a limit and a meaning at a glance. Tones: default ink, warning amber, critical red. If there is no limit, it is not a meter — use Progress for work being done.
a11y: role="meter" with aria-valuenow/min/max and a label. The visible number next to it carries the same information as the bar.
